### Key Risks

- **Extreme drowsiness and dizziness:** Their sedative effects amplify each other, increasing the chance of falls, accidents, and trouble waking up.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX2CadJswcj9BD2KSLZUu2hgPXJ2HGnyzCV-eJAPssd0Tgm8wvSdYK3ntIbfKb5FvJFQwXZj7PKeWxbSohzb-snp8uK_5lrV7mzkvhnUlyXXZrzck2YhiZi6mYLsZNYXyxiphXX7n5JvYb)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXX9IAVHho7HwclKNsSNNAENvd93WZdG4vUdTku7u7Ma6y08y_00nLEt_--AAZvVMHCMG2TEpGeKyKEd0pYGAkuoaBWUMlN88y9zpn8EWnsXu9ie-Qzll86OAor8FT0Iaoe21kieKBOXlmcP7NmvIOcNype)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1xWXAfxEjAHmHSEd8e_-WsoxPNwK1oPyQsPzX_dJYqLLyU-ulRmfzpsKd0qdnXEOe8Gb-3iVd740hp9_mVfmCyfPU7VfQSf3i7kz08Uumor3shzVKft6OYRX7DpHYM2DB78XCzH7woZ5FPyl0vXEIUN8iOnvTOtgT6ngza_sLHMHfSJalIDDYpQU-w)
- **Impaired driving and coordination:** Reaction time, judgment, and motor skills drop sharply—even if you feel alert.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXT4g5-4iZ8r1NRxFrPfza4-FRkYxbNuDtM2FagHRpBVkarsroW0HbDClqtoYDk9Cu1-iSa1JBHFDzYfu49a2VI6qQLiUvIi7nF3ImREXU-AXEa4URDtfSlwfkwCI0KZEPDJszuGSyXA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXX9IAVHho7HwclKNsSNNAENvd93WZdG4vUdTku7u7Ma6y08y_00nLEt_--AAZvVMHCMG2TEpGeKyKEd0pYGAkuoaBWUMlN88y9zpn8EWnsXu9ie-Qzll86OAor8FT0Iaoe21kieKBOXlmcP7NmvIOcNype)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXXq9cp0mORoJxCOU0Cbml4Afve0Y8TytZ2ARkwXJQ6VLEQb2q8i_Ao4hOw-WG8le6wVPTW8uLssQj4WiueIthu95kAQSGK9StRkWFykthbBJuTGBDgZ-sk9uRff-01K759X0lrx--ov2K7ynnfNMreCKKCEg)
- **Severe breathing and overdose risks:** Heavy combining can cause dangerously slow breathing, confusion, hallucinations, or loss of consciousness, especially in older adults or when mixed with other sedatives.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXMZ-SdE3SOswlQrJTWEIlXMZpC0PME_VYEw8i1HmfeWc8yCZMz1JCpQ5yMmFzLQYfSY8EfTyGOVCGz_SoUzCeJtf7z_umy9CEM3ZXJQyyq2I40oYnrs6x3pu1f_UzIGs6wx-awfl1)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX2CadJswcj9BD2KSLZUu2hgPXJ2HGnyzCV-eJAPssd0Tgm8wvSdYK3ntIbfKb5FvJFQwXZj7PKeWxbSohzb-snp8uK_5lrV7mzkvhnUlyXXZrzck2YhiZi6mYLsZNYXyxiphXX7n5JvYb)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXT4g5-4iZ8r1NRxFrPfza4-FRkYxbNuDtM2FagHRpBVkarsroW0HbDClqtoYDk9Cu1-iSa1JBHFDzYfu49a2VI6qQLiUvIi7nF3ImREXU-AXEa4URDtfSlwfkwCI0KZEPDJszuGSyXA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXXq9cp0mORoJxCOU0Cbml4Afve0Y8TytZ2ARkwXJQ6VLEQb2q8i_Ao4hOw-WG8le6wVPTW8uLssQj4WiueIthu95kAQSGK9StRkWFykthbBJuTGBDgZ-sk9uRff-01K759X0lrx--ov2K7ynnfNMreCKKCEg)

### Practical Precautions

- **Avoid mixing them:** Skip alcohol while taking Benadryl, and do not take Benadryl to sleep after drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXXq9cp0mORoJxCOU0Cbml4Afve0Y8TytZ2ARkwXJQ6VLEQb2q8i_Ao4hOw-WG8le6wVPTW8uLssQj4WiueIthu95kAQSGK9StRkWFykthbBJuTGBDgZ-sk9uRff-01K759X0lrx--ov2K7ynnfNMreCKKCEg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXX9IAVHho7HwclKNsSNNAENvd93WZdG4vUdTku7u7Ma6y08y_00nLEt_--AAZvVMHCMG2TEpGeKyKEd0pYGAkuoaBWUMlN88y9zpn8EWnsXu9ie-Qzll86OAor8FT0Iaoe21kieKBOXlmcP7NmvIOcNype)

- **Watch for hidden ingredients:** Check labels on "PM" products, cold/flu syrups, and laxatives, as they may contain diphenhydramine or hidden alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXX9IAVHho7HwclKNsSNNAENvd93WZdG4vUdTku7u7Ma6y08y_00nLEt_--AAZvVMHCMG2TEpGeKyKEd0pYGAkuoaBWUMlN88y9zpn8EWnsXu9ie-Qzll86OAor8FT0Iaoe21kieKBOXlmcP7NmvIOcNype)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXXq9cp0mORoJxCOU0Cbml4Afve0Y8TytZ2ARkwXJQ6VLEQb2q8i_Ao4hOw-WG8le6wVPTW8uLssQj4WiueIthu95kAQSGK9StRkWFykthbBJuTGBDgZ-sk9uRff-01K759X0lrx--ov2K7ynnfNMreCKKCEg)
